sentences.text: The SSG scheme refers to the Skill Support Grant.
It is designed to enhance the employability of youth in India.
The primary objective is to provide financial assistance for skill development.
The scheme aims to support individuals in acquiring skills that are in demand in the job market.
Eligible beneficiaries include youth aged between 15 and 29 years.
The scheme targets individuals from economically weaker sections.
Financial assistance is provided to cover the costs of skill training programs.
The amount of assistance varies based on the type of training.
The application process involves submitting an online application through the designated portal.
Applicants must provide necessary documentation to verify their eligibility.
The timeline for processing applications is typically within a few weeks.
The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship.
State governments may also play a role in the local implementation of the scheme.
The SSG scheme is part of the broader National Skill Development Mission.
It aims to create a skilled workforce to meet the needs of various industries.
Regular monitoring and evaluation are conducted to assess the impact of the scheme.
